subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept Telegram album/sendMediaGroup support in the bundled Telegram plugin now, and should the open external draft be ported or superseded?
rationale: This is a new user-visible Telegram capability with an open implementation candidate, and choosing the permanent action shape and fallback behavior requires maintainer product direction before automation should open a separate fix PR.

options.title: Port album support now
options.body: Accept the feature direction and port or repair the open draft into current Telegram send/action/reply/outbound paths with focused Telegram proof.

options.title: Narrow the scope first
options.body: Limit the first change to one owner path such as message.send mediaUrls albums, leaving reply/outbound batching for a separate issue.

options.title: Keep sequential sends
options.body: Decline album grouping for now and close the feature after documenting sequential media delivery as the supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Port album support now
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction and port or repair the open draft into current Telegram send/action/reply/outbound paths with focused Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact issue and is the strongest current-history owner for the touched Telegram send surfaces.
